records.summary: Added Bitquery's independent nine-chain on-chain trace. It reports all 17 drained Binance hot wallets carry Binance PoR labels, including the five XRPL source accounts; this partially resolves XRP wallet-label membership but not customer-liability coverage. Bitquery explicitly states the XRPL receiver shares no address with the rest of the attack, so the graph now keeps ETH and XRP receiver clusters separate and links them only at incident-event level. The 233.5M XRP receiver balance is only current through October 30 06:43 UTC and is stale. Public ETH transfer totals do not fully reconcile (195,469.6 source-transfer sum, 195,460 reported transfer, 197,460 later stash balance, ~204,500 aggregate). No market feature or forecast was admitted.
